notes: One entry per catalog part. The site loads only the parts in the current build. Images live in parts/img/<slot>/<id>.webp. Coordinates are in the part image's own pixels; the renderer converts them using inches.

schema.slot: upper | lower | barrel | handguard | muzzle | stock | grip | mag | optic | trigger | magrel | ...
schema.img: parts/img/<slot>/<id>.webp (null = drawn procedurally, e.g. barrel, charging handle)
schema.size_in: [length, height] the image represents, in inches
schema.anchors: named points in image px, e.g. lower: {pinRear:[x,y], pinFront:[x,y], magwellFront:[x,y], magwellRear:[x,y], earFront:[x,y], earRear:[x,y], bodyTop:y, holes:[...]}
schema.checks: results of orientation / size / anchor checks from the pipeline
schema.color_variants: optional: other catalog ids that reuse this cut-out with a tint
